image: Flag of the Community of Madrid.svg
name: Community of Madrid
summary: A crimson field with seven white five-pointed stars in two rows, representing the Plough (Ursa Major). Designed by the poet Santiago Amón.
origin: The Community of Madrid was created in 1983. Its flag uses the crimson of Castile and the stars of the city of Madrid's arms.

symbols.name: Seven stars
symbols.description: White stars in two rows of four and three.
symbols.meaning: Ursa Major, from the city of Madrid's arms; also the mountain ranges near the capital.

facts: The same seven stars appear on the arms of the city, around a bear eating from a strawberry tree.
clues: Its stars form a famous constellation.
The flag of the region around Spain's capital.
